deviations.claim_in_article: “Oil prices did not fall across the whole market” and “oil prices stayed high.”
deviations.issue: The article generalizes the reported Brent-futures movement to oil prices across the market. The ledger verifies the short-term movement and reporting-time price only for Brent futures.
deviations.explanation: The scope is broadened from Brent futures to oil prices generally; this is a scope change. The same broad framing appears in the Japanese source.
